author: Gordon Thelander
releaseNotes:
1.9.0 - Hub Variables now appear on the map. A rule that sets or reads a Hub Variable draws a line to it - a new triangular node, distinct from devices and apps - so two rules quietly talking to each other through shared state are finally visible instead of invisible. Detected from a condition, a trigger, a Required Expression, or a variable referenced in free text (e.g. a Notification message), each confirmed against real Rule Machine fixtures rather than guessed. Two new pivot-table presets, 'Rule -> Hub Variables' and 'Hub Variable -> Rules'.

Still checkpointed locally against JimB's own hub testing of 1.8.9 - see the community thread before this goes further.

Jim Becker (JimB) credited in the README as primary tester and functional requirements contributor - this feature exists because he asked for it.
